title: Muse Spark Open (Free for limited time) API: Pricing, Benchmarks & Docs | Together AI
gist: Together AI's model page for Meta's Muse Spark Open advertises a free serverless promo through October 18, 2026 before billing at $1.25/$4.25 per 1M tokens, repeating Meta's agentic coding and multimodal positioning but carrying no benchmarks.

insights.claim: Together AI is offering Muse Spark Open free on its serverless API through October 18, 2026 at 12:00 PM PT, after which usage bills at $1.25 per 1M input and $4.25 per 1M output tokens.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: A time-limited free tier is a customer-acquisition play; watch conversion to paid usage after the cutoff.

insights.claim: The free offer requires new accounts to add a payment method and purchase a minimum of $15 in credits (not consumed while using the free model), and Together may end or change the offer early at its sole discretion.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Credit-purchase gating converts free-trial users into funded accounts.

insights.claim: Meta describes Muse Spark Open as the most capable US open-weights model to date, a coding-optimized model trained on real developer workflows with a 1M-token context window.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Positions Meta's open weights as the US answer in the open-model race.
insights.quote: the most capable US open-weights model to date

insights.claim: The model is built as an agentic model that plans, acts, observes and self-corrects, browses with multimodal browsing, spawns subagents, uses computer-use across desktop, mobile and browser, and emits separate intent commentary before acting.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Agent-native design matches the shift of inference spend toward long-horizon tasks.

insights.claim: The model card page says full architecture details and benchmarks arrive with the launch materials, so the page itself publishes no benchmark numbers.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Performance claims on this page are unverified; wait for Meta's published benchmarks.

insights.claim: Together offers Muse Spark Open on serverless with a stated 99.9% SLA and dedicated infrastructure, with the model released October 15, 2026 and listed at 816B parameters and 1M context.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: SLA-backed hosting of open models is the neocloud pitch to enterprises.

insights.claim: The page lists related Together models with prices, e.g. Muse Spark Open at $0.15 cached / $1.25 input / $4.25 output per 1M tokens versus NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL at $0.02 / $0.15 / $0.50 and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash at $0.006 / $0.30 / $1.20.
insights.speaker: Together AI Blog
insights.so_what: Shows a wide price spread across open models, with Muse Spark Open priced well above smaller open peers.
